summary: RAG in-context topology on champion LoRA adapter v2a_e1
hypothesis: Grafting the ragJustifiedQuestions in-context topology (exp022) onto the champion LoRA adapter v2a_e1 should improve over the raw in-context baseline, because the adapter's fine-tuned judgment might amplify the RAG retrieval signal rather than rely on it alone.
technique: A matrix sweep crossing all inference topologies against the best LoRA adapters: specifically, the ragJustifiedQuestions retrieval-augmented in-context pipeline (exp022) re-run with the champion LoRA adapter v2a_e1 substituted in place of the stock base model, using greedy decoding.
result: Scored 0.340 on the full-30 greedy gate — above the raw exp022 in-context baseline (0.302) but well short of the champion exp056 (0.440). The LoRA adapter did lift the RAG topology modestly, but the gap to the best known configuration remained large; discarded as the cross did not produce a competitive pipeline.
